observations.note:
INSTANCE TWO of the multi-element temporal composition gap. INSTANCE ONE is C04-051, logged at exclusions.json entry C04-051#continue-supply, observation id C04-051#temporal-composition. Read them together; the eventual ruling session should not have to rediscover the connection.

THIS ITEM'S TEMPORAL IS COMPOSED OF THREE ELEMENTS: 'within [...***...] days of the Effective Date' AND 'thereafter by [...***...] of each Calendar Year' AND 'during the Term'. One verb ('submit'), one performance, one item -- so §4.3 is not engaged; what is composed is the TIMING, not the duty.

WHY IT IS THE SAME GAP AS INSTANCE ONE AND NOT §8.11's. §8.11's decisive test for lead_time_unrepresentable was that 'granting free composition of all five v1 forms does NOT rescue the clause', because no form pairs a duration with a direction. BOTH INSTANCES COME OUT THE OTHER WAY: each element here has a v1 form of its own, verified by execution against the production classifier -- 'within 30 days of the Effective Date' -> WITHIN 30d OF "the Effective Date"; 'by 31 December of each Calendar Year' -> BY "31 December of each Calendar Year". Free composition WOULD rescue the clause. What IR v1 lacks is not a form for any element but THE ABILITY TO HOLD MORE THAN ONE TEMPORAL AT ALL -- ast.Obligation carries a single temporal field.

THE TWO INSTANCES FAIL THROUGH DIFFERENT REGEXES, AND THAT IS WHY THE PAIR IS WORTH MORE THAN EITHER ALONE. Instance one is greedy _RELATIVE_RE ('^(before|after)\s+(.+)$'); instance two is greedy _WITHIN_RE. BOTH SILENTLY COMPILE, swallowing the surplus bounds into the trigger string rather than raising UNMAPPABLE_TEMPORAL:
  instance one: 'after expiry of the said 6-month period and during the Term of this Agreement, or until Bellicum has secured...' -> AFTER "expiry of the said 6-month period and during the Term of this Agreement, or until Bellicum has secured..."
  instance two (unredacted paraphrase): 'within 30 days of the Effective Date, and thereafter by 31 December of each Calendar Year during the Term' -> WITHIN 30d OF "the Effective Date, and thereafter by 31 December of each Calendar Year during the Term"
THE SHARED CAUSE IS THE TRAILING '(.+)$' CAPTURE both patterns end with. So the silent-swallow is a property of the classifier's SHAPE, not a quirk of one pattern, and a fix aimed at one regex would leave the other.

WHY THIS ITEM IS NOT TAGGED FOR IT TODAY. Reviewer-approved 2026-09-20, option (a): the item locks with known_gaps ['redacted_value'] alone, and the temporal_composition amendment is taken as its OWN scoped §10 ruling rather than inside an annotation pass. Under F19's precedent this item does owe a second tag -- F19 ruled E03-01 owes lead_time_unrepresentable even though its temporal is already null from redaction and known_gaps is not one of §5's eight scored clauses.

COST OF THE EVENTUAL AMENDMENT, measured rather than estimated. MEMBERSHIP DOES NOT MOVE: this item is already outside §9.1's in-force denominator on redacted_value (WITHHELD_VALUE, an excluding kind), so adding a second excluding tag is EXCLUSION-NEUTRAL -- F19's own situation. RESTAMPING IS FREE: no batch-4 segment has a cassette (all 12 recorded segments are batch 1/2), so §22's conforming blocker does not attach to either instance.

DIRECTION IS DELIBERATELY NOT PRE-SELECTED, per the reviewer's instruction. INCOMPLETENESS is the obvious read, but the greedy swallow yields a trigger string asserting a WRONG window rather than a missing one, which is closer to a misstatement -- the same distinction F19 weighed before rejecting OVERSTATING on semantics. Decide it in the ruling session, on the mechanism, not here.

SEARCH KEY: temporal composition, instance two, greedy (.+)$ capture, _WITHIN_RE, _RELATIVE_RE, C04-051, C04-072.

RULED 2026-09-23 -- F21, guideline v0.63, §8.12, and THIS INSTANCE IS THE ONE THE RULING RESTS ON. Tag `temporal_composition`, kind REPRESENTATIONAL, direction DEFERRED BY RULING (not omitted -- gap_kinds.DIRECTION_DEFERRED records it, and F21 asks whether direction is per-tag or per-item at all). Item C04-08 now carries it. ONE CLAIM ABOVE IS CORRECTED: 'each element here has a v1 form of its own' is true of TWO of the three, not three -- 'during the Term' classifies to None, verified through the production classifier alongside the two the note already checked. The correction does NOT touch the distinction from §8.11, which needs only that free composition WOULD rescue the deadline pair, and it does here. DIRECTION WAS ARGUED AND DEFERRED RATHER THAN SPLIT THE DIFFERENCE: this item drops an ADDITIVE recurring deadline (INCOMPLETENESS-shaped) AND a NARROWING scope bound (OVERSTATING-shaped) in one sentence, so no tag-level value describes it -- assigning one would certify a direction that does not describe what is wrong with this item, which is the failure §9.1 ground 2 exists to prevent. THE SCOPE IS THE SLOT LIMIT, NOT THE GREEDY SWALLOW: the swallow is the symptom in cases where the surplus sits inside the quoted phrase, so C02-047's logged near-miss IS in scope under the ruling and C02-07 is tagged -- while the INSTANCE COUNT behind the amendment stays at two, because that count is about the forcing function and not about the tag's reach. E03-01 is swept in on the same scope, from §8.11's own observation that its note 'omits during the Term entirely'. EXPOSURE IS THREE ITEMS (E03-01, C02-07, C04-08), all three already outside §9.1's in-force denominator on existing tags, so the amendment is EXCLUSION-NEUTRAL -- confirmed by a real run_scoring.run() before and after, not hand-computed. No item restamped, no cassette staled.
